local library, extEnv = ...

if not library then
	warn("ESP Lite: no Arceus X UI library passed to this script. Install it as an Arceus X extension.")
	return
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

local store = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if store.__ESPLiteUnload then
	pcall(store.__ESPLiteUnload)
end

local cfg = {
	refresh = 0.5,
	rescanEvery = 6,
	maxDistance = 2000,
}

local colors = {
	Players = Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255),
	Monsters = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
	Items = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60),
}

local running = true
local state = { Players = false, Monsters = false, Items = false, Fullbright = false }
local dirty = { Players = true, Monsters = true, Items = true }
local tracked = { Players = {}, Monsters = {}, Items = {} }

local function getRoot()
	local ok, ui = pcall(function()
		return gethui and gethui()
	end)
	if ok and ui then
		return ui
	end
	local ok2 = pcall(function()
		return CoreGui.Name
	end)
	if ok2 then
		return CoreGui
	end
	return lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local container = Instance.new("Folder")
container.Name = "ESPLiteContainer"
container.Parent = getRoot()

local function getPart(inst)
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return inst
	end
	if inst:IsA("Tool") then
		return inst:FindFirstChild("Handle") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	if inst:IsA("Model") then
		return inst.PrimaryPart or inst:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	return nil
end

local function myPosition()
	local char = lp.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

local function makeTag(cat, key, label, withHighlight)
	local part = getPart(key)
	if not part then
		return
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Adornee = part
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 26)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = cfg.maxDistance
	gui.Parent = container

	local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	txt.TextColor3 = colors[cat]
	txt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	txt.TextScaled = true
	txt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	txt.Text = label
	txt.Parent = gui

	local hl
	if withHighlight then
		hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Adornee = key
		hl.FillColor = colors[cat]
		hl.OutlineColor = colors[cat]
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.7
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = container
	end

	tracked[cat][key] = { gui = gui, hl = hl, txt = txt, label = label, part = part }
end

local function removeTag(cat, key)
	local data = tracked[cat][key]
	if data then
		pcall(function()
			data.gui:Destroy()
		end)
		if data.hl then
			pcall(function()
				data.hl:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		tracked[cat][key] = nil
	end
end

local function clearCat(cat)
	for key in pairs(tracked[cat]) do
		removeTag(cat, key)
	end
end

local scanners = {}

scanners.Players = function()
	local wanted = {}
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= lp and plr.Character then
			wanted[plr.Character] = plr.DisplayName
		end
	end
	return wanted
end

scanners.Monsters = function()
	local wanted = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Humanoid") then
			local m = d.Parent
			if m and m:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) and d.Health > 0 then
				wanted[m] = m.Name
			end
		end
	end
	return wanted
end

scanners.Items = function()
	local wanted = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			local holder = d.Parent
			if holder and holder:IsA("Attachment") then
				holder = holder.Parent
			end
			if holder and not holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				local name = d.ObjectText
				if name == "" then
					name = holder.Name
				end
				wanted[holder] = name
			end
		elseif d:IsA("Tool") then
			local p = d.Parent
			if p and not p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p) then
				wanted[d] = d.Name
			end
		end
	end
	return wanted
end

local function sync(cat)
	local wanted = scanners[cat]()
	for key in pairs(tracked[cat]) do
		if not wanted[key] or not key.Parent then
			removeTag(cat, key)
		end
	end
	for key, label in pairs(wanted) do
		if not tracked[cat][key] then
			makeTag(cat, key, label, cat ~= "Items")
		end
	end
end

local function updateDistances(cat)
	local me = myPosition()
	for key, data in pairs(tracked[cat]) do
		if not key.Parent or not data.part or not data.part.Parent then
			removeTag(cat, key)
		else
			data.gui.MaxDistance = cfg.maxDistance
			if me then
				local d = math.floor((data.part.Position - me).Magnitude)
				data.txt.Text = data.label .. " [" .. d .. "]"
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Fullbright
local origLight = nil

local function applyFullbright()
	if not origLight then
		origLight = {
			Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
			ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
			FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
			FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
			GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
			Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
			OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
		}
	end
	Lighting.Brightness = 2
	Lighting.ClockTime = 14
	Lighting.FogStart = 0
	Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
end

local function restoreLighting()
	if origLight then
		for k, v in pairs(origLight) do
			pcall(function()
				Lighting[k] = v
			end)
		end
		origLight = nil
	end
end

-- Hub UI (Arceus X extension UI library)
library:SetTitle("ESP Lite")

local espPage = library:AddPage("ESP", "rbxassetid://5538771889")
local visualPage = library:AddPage("Visuals", "rbxassetid://5538771889")

espPage:AddCategoryTitle("Targets", "Pick what to highlight")

local function bindToggle(page, title, desc, key)
	local t = page:AddToggle(title, desc, false)
	t.OnToggle:Connect(function(v)
		state[key] = v and true or false
		if dirty[key] ~= nil then
			dirty[key] = true
		end
		if key == "Fullbright" and not state[key] then
			restoreLighting()
		end
	end)
	return t
end

bindToggle(espPage, "Player ESP", "Blue outline, name and distance", "Players")
bindToggle(espPage, "Monster ESP", "Red outline on non-player NPCs", "Monsters")
bindToggle(espPage, "Item ESP", "Yellow labels on pickups and tools", "Items")

espPage:AddCategoryTitle("Settings", "ESP range")

local rangeSlider = espPage:AddSlider("Max distance", "Studs", 2000, 100, 5000)
rangeSlider.ValueUpdated:Connect(function(n)
	cfg.maxDistance = n
end)

visualPage:AddCategoryTitle("Lighting", "Client side only")
bindToggle(visualPage, "Fullbright", "Max light, no fog, no shadows", "Fullbright")

local clearBtn = visualPage:AddButton("Clear ESP", "Remove every label right now", "Clear")
clearBtn.OnClick:Connect(function()
	for _, cat in ipairs({ "Players", "Monsters", "Items" }) do
		clearCat(cat)
		dirty[cat] = true
	end
end)

-- Main loop
task.spawn(function()
	local n = 0
	while running do
		n = n + 1
		local doScan = (n % cfg.rescanEvery == 1)
		for _, cat in ipairs({ "Players", "Monsters", "Items" }) do
			if state[cat] then
				if doScan or dirty[cat] then
					pcall(sync, cat)
					dirty[cat] = false
				end
				pcall(updateDistances, cat)
			else
				clearCat(cat)
			end
		end
		if state.Fullbright then
			pcall(applyFullbright)
		end
		task.wait(cfg.refresh)
	end
end)

store.__ESPLiteUnload = function()
	running = false
	for _, cat in ipairs({ "Players", "Monsters", "Items" }) do
		clearCat(cat)
	end
	restoreLighting()
	pcall(function()
		container:Destroy()
	end)
end
